# zBTC: Bitcoin–Zenon Interoperability Protocol Specification (`v2.5.0-rfc`)

> Public RFC technical specification for storing native BTC in BitVM2-constrained Taproot vaults, representing it 1:1 as feeless `zBTC` on Zenon's block-lattice via an atomic Treasury Pre-Mint `SettlementContract`, verifying Bitcoin via an adversarially-bounded optimistic SPV authorization domain (`d_btc_asset`), anchoring history via 30-day BLS12-381 `min-sig` finality committees, and providing peg-free PTLC adaptor swaps and Lightning submarine-swap gateways.

- **Status:** Public RFC (`v2.5.0-rfc`) — pre-implementation design specification open for adversarial public & AI-agent review. NOT mainnet-active.
- **Canonical Web Site:** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec
- **Single-Fetch Full Bundle (for LLMs):** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/llms-full.txt
- **Executable Numeric Oracle:** `python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`

## Normative Specification Files (Raw Markdown & HTML)

Read in authority-precedence order (`SPEC.md §2.1`):

- [Master Overview (`SPEC.md`)](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/SPEC.md): Architecture, end-to-end flows, 5-assumption honest threat model, upstream amendment register (`A-SPEC-1..6`, `A-BTC-1`, `A-MINT-1`, `A-PILLAR-1`), and staged verification gates. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/
- [Part 1 — Bitcoin Taproot Vault Enforcement (`BTC-ENFORCEMENT-V1`)](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/01-bitcoin-taproot-vault-enforcement.md): 4-key registry, fixed 408 B 2-slot BLS12-381 cert DA, per-block `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS + 7-chunk Leaf-3B SHA-256 (`29,882 vB -> 30 kvB`, `C = 1,208`), staggered `46d / 56d / 58d` CLTVs, 30-day rotation schedule, exact integer-satoshi BitVM2 economics (`F_assert = 1.45 BTC`, `Bond = 3.70 BTC`), Tier 1B/2, 11-item wind-down plan. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-01/
- [Part 2 — Bitcoin Authorization Domain (`d_btc_asset`) & SPV Verifier](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/02-btc-authorization-domain-and-spv.md): 17 input tags (`0x00..0x10`), never-pruned `ActiveChainByHeight[h]`, streaming SHA-256 tx verifier, multi-gen `TrackedVaultRecord`, verifier-decided SMT inclusion vs all-epoch absence `BTC_VAULT_SPEND_PROOF`, decoupled `BTC_RELEASE_PROOF`, single-authority anti-censorship `PEGOUT_SLOT_CLAIMED`, halving-indexed `K_pilot = 14`, and 29 SPV conformance vectors. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-02/
- [Part 3 — Settlement Contract, Atomic Treasury `zBTC`, Plasma & Peg-Free Rails](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/03-settlement-minted-zbtc-and-feeless-rails.md): `TokenContract.IssueMinted` -> single-use `ReceiveTreasury()`, `BatchCommitmentV3` + inductive `StepTraceLeaf` (`328 B`), bounded Multi-Tx Sessions (`8,676 B` @ depth 256), latency- & reservation-aware `G-21`, aligned cross-store vault state machine, `500 ZNN` `SlotBondZnn`, BIP-327 tweaked PTLC adaptor swaps, and LN HTLC submarine-swap gateway. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-03/
- [Part 4 — Bitcoin Anchoring & Light Client Verification](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/04-bitcoin-anchoring-and-light-client.md): Genesis BTC block `710,968`, `finalityDigest` anchoring, `proof-format.md` V1 SMT proofs, 30-day BLS12-381 `min-sig` `FinalityCommitteeRoot` (distinct IETF POP DSTs, depth-5 SHA-256 tree), historical-root full-preimage `SubmitInvalidCertProof`, U2 finality gadget, `72`-day post-committee-service stake lock, and anti-frontier boundary. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-04/
- [Part 5 — Detailed `go-zenon` Node Upgrade Plan](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/05-go-zenon-upgrade-plan.md): Phases `U0`–`U5` verified against `go-zenon` `origin/release/0.0.11-rc1` (`f19955f`) and `origin/dev` (`770e893`), `GovernanceContract` + `MultisigContract` Stage 1B hard gate, `ChallengeDepositZnn` priority lane, and CI conformance gates. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-05/

## Instructions for LLMs & Autonomous Review Agents

You are explicitly invited to **adversarially audit this specification**, try to break its cryptographic, game-theoretic, consensus, or state-machine invariants, and submit structured GitHub Issues or Pull Requests to improve it.

### 1. How to Ingest & Verify This Spec

1. Fetch the entire normative corpus in one request via `https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/llms-full.txt`, or clone `https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec`.
2. Run the executable oracle locally (do NOT trust prose numbers without checking):
   ```bash
   python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py
   ```
   Every modeled number in `SPEC.md` and `spec/01..05` MUST match the oracle's exact integer output.
3. Respect the **non-blocking empirical gates** vs **design-spec defects** distinction:
   - Unmeasured Signet BitVM2 / market constants prefixed `ASSUMED_STAGE_0C_TARGET_` in `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py` are **already disclosed Stage 0C measurement gates (Gate G-2)**, not hidden assumptions.
   - Tier 1A is explicitly **NOT trustless** — it discloses **5 explicit assumptions** (`SPEC.md §4`), including altruistic watcher capital (`-1.46 BTC` EV vs self-slasher/MEV) and `1-of-N` live `Q_graph` / Setup Committee honesty. Do not file issues claiming the spec hides these unless you found an *additional undisclosed* trust assumption or a bypass of one of the 5 stated bounds!
   - Upstream amendments in `SPEC.md §6` (`A-SPEC-1..6`, `A-BTC-1`, `A-MINT-1`, `A-PILLAR-1`) are explicitly flagged as blocking mainnet registration.

### 2. High-Value Adversarial Audit Checklist

When reviewing `v2.5.0-rfc`, prioritize attacking:
1. **Bitcoin Script & BitVM2 DAG (`spec/01`)**: Tapscript `OP_CLTV`/`OP_CSV`/sighash interactions, per-block `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS checksums & Leaf-3B SHA-256 stack limits (`<= 1,000` elements, `<= 400 kWU`), fee-bumping / 1p1c package relay / pinning vectors, operator self-slashing / griefing / bond-escape paths, staggered `46d < 56d < 58d` expiry races.
2. **Finality Slashing & BLS12-381 (`spec/04`, `spec/05`)**: Historical-root `SubmitInvalidCertProof` edge cases, rogue-key / PoP DST separation, `FinalityCommitteeRoot` depth-5 SHA-256 Merkle tree, `72`-day post-committee-service Pillar lock vs `58d` bond expiry, inner STARK vs outer BN254 Groth16 circuit constraints.
3. **SPV Domain & Cross-Store State Machine (`spec/02`, `spec/03`)**: Races or deadlocks between `d_btc_asset` (`TrackedVaultRecord`, `PegOutState`, `RecoveredVaultMap`) and `SettlementContract` (`VaultUtxoSet`, `PegOutRecord`, `OperatorLaneState`), SMT grinding past `12 KiB` vs Multi-Tx Witness Session bounds (`8,676 B` @ depth 256), `BTC_VAULT_SPEND_PROOF` inclusion/absence across `ACTIVE`/`RELEASED`/`QUARANTINED`, fronting slot expiry & anti-censorship (`500 ZNN` `SlotBondZnn`, `lastLapsedOperatorId`), and latency-aware `G-21` capacity across 30-day rotations.
4. **`go-zenon` Ground Truth (`spec/05`)**: Verify any cited line or behavior against `https://github.com/zenon-network/go-zenon` (`origin/dev` `770e893` / `origin/release/0.0.11-rc1` `f19955f`), especially `TokenContract.IssueMinted -> ReceiveTreasury()`, `vm/vm.go`, `pillars.go`, `ptlc.go`, and `htlc.go`.
5. **Peg-Free Rails (`spec/03 §5`)**: BIP-327 tweaked MuSig2 adaptor signature math, odd-`y(R')` parity handling, timelock ordering (`T_znn >= T_btc_worst + 6h`), and LN Hold Invoice `ACCEPTED`-first invariant.

### 3. How to Submit a GitHub Issue (Adversarial Finding or Proposal)

Open an issue at **https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec/issues/new/choose** (or via GitHub CLI `gh issue create --repo btc-moonshot/spec`).

Use this exact structure so maintainers and fellow reviewers can verify your finding rapidly:
- **Title:** `[SEVERITY] Short concrete summary` (e.g., `[HIGH] Bypass in ...` or `[MEDIUM] Race between ...` or `[RFC] Proposal to adjust ...`)
- **Severity:** `CRITICAL` (loss of funds / unbacked mint / permanent lock), `HIGH` (broken core security property or unbuildable mechanism), `MEDIUM` (edge-case liveness/griefing/honest-operator loss), `LOW` (erratum, numeric slip, missing detail), or `ORACLE` (bug in `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`).
- **Exact Citations:** File path + section + line numbers (e.g., `spec/01-bitcoin-taproot-vault-enforcement.md §3.4`, `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py:245`).
- **Concrete Attack Trace or Reproduction:** Step-by-step trace with exact tx/call sequence, state transitions, or Python reproduction snippet showing the violated invariant.
- **Minimal Proposed Fix:** Concrete normative diff or parameter change (and whether it changes any value in `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`).

### 4. How to Submit a Pull Request to Adjust the Spec

Open a PR against `main` at **https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec/pulls**:
1. Fork & branch from `main` (`git checkout -b fix/<short-slug>`).
2. Edit the affected canonical files (`SPEC.md`, `spec/01..05`, and `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`). Keep ALL cross-file numbers, struct sizes, ABI limits, and threat-model disclosures 100% synchronized!
3. Run the mandatory verification checks BEFORE opening your PR:
   ```bash
   python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py
   npm ci && npm run build
   ```
   GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/verify-oracle.yml`) enforces both checks on every PR.
4. Keep `public/raw/` and `public/llms-full.txt` synced by running `npm run sync:spec` (included in `package.json`) before committing so the static site, raw downloads, and LLM bundle never drift from the root Markdown files!
5. In your PR description, link the Issue (if any), state the exact invariant changed, confirm oracle pass output, and disclose any new trust assumption or Stage 0C measurement target honestly.
